'''2016 Worlds Day 3 Tom Haid LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Tom Haid]] at [[2016 World Championship]] (Day 3).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Tom Haid]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 World Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 3
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-world-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013125623/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-world-championships.html Internet Archive]
